label: D1 reward after an unrewarded trial, agent about to choose a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass at D1, 99.9% with in_rew==1); never at GO or D2, never on unrewarded D1. Within rewarded D1 it is selective: it prefers a reward that follows an unrewarded trial (surprising reward; activations rise with low model value, zero for value > 8.1), an upcoming a1 choice (89% of mass; choice logit moderately positive 2.8-8, not saturated), and late episode (rate climbs steadily from trial 0 to 90+). Top activations are rewards after a run of losses or around reversals. Predicate (rewarded D1, previous trial unrewarded, about to choose a1) gives dev F1 0.45 (P 0.34, R 0.67); rewarded D1 alone has recall ~1 but precision 0.06. The only FUTURE variable is action, which is the agent own upcoming choice (choice>0 logit gives similar results). Many misses are at the window start where the two-back reward is unknown. Adding ep_trial>=40 raises F1 to 0.51 but was not recorded for simplicity.
